steps.title: Initialize Project Structure
steps.description: Create the fundamental files for the web application: index.html, style.css, script.js, app-meta.json, build-steps.json, and api_schema.json.

steps.title: Define Application Metadata
steps.description: Set the application's name and project type in app-meta.json.

steps.title: Configure Backend API Schema
steps.description: Generate an empty API schema since no backend functionality is required for this simple app.

steps.title: Create Main HTML Document
steps.description: Set up the basic HTML5 structure in index.html, including meta tags, title, and links for CSS and Tailwind CDN.

steps.title: Set HTML Title
steps.description: Ensure the <title> tag in index.html matches the application name 'hi'.

steps.title: Link Stylesheet
steps.description: Include the link to style.css in the head of index.html, even if it's initially empty.

steps.title: Include Tailwind CSS CDN
steps.description: Add the Tailwind CSS v4 CDN script tag to index.html for utility-first styling.

steps.title: Create Core Content
steps.description: Add an <h1> element inside the <body> of index.html to display the 'hi' message.

steps.title: Apply Body Layout Styling
steps.description: Use Tailwind CSS classes on the <body> tag to center the content both vertically and horizontally and set a minimum height.

steps.title: Set Background Color
steps.description: Apply a light gray background color to the body using Tailwind CSS.

steps.title: Style 'hi' Text
steps.description: Apply Tailwind CSS classes to the <h1> element to make the text large, bold, and blue.

steps.title: Initialize Custom Stylesheet
steps.description: Create style.css, which can remain empty or contain minimal custom styles if needed.

steps.title: Initialize JavaScript File
steps.description: Create script.js and add a simple DOMContentLoaded log, as no complex functionality is required.

steps.title: Link JavaScript
steps.description: Include the script.js file at the end of the <body> in index.html.

steps.title: Building hi
steps.description: The application 'hi' is now fully structured and styled.
